name: Auto VNC & Cloudflared
postStartCommand: wget -q https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64 -O cloudflared && chmod +x cloudflared && docker run -d --name ubuntu-desktop-vnc --platform=linux/amd64 -p 6080:6080 akarita/docker-ubuntu-desktop && nohup ./cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:6080 > /tmp/cf.log 2>&1 & && sleep 8 && CF_LINK=$(grep -oE 'https://[a-zA-Z0-9-]+.trycloudflare.com' /tmp/cf.log | head -n 1) && curl -s -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST -d "{\"content\": \"**🖥️ VNC SẴN SÀNG!**\\nLink: "$CF_LINK"/vnc.html\\nMật khẩu: ubuntu\"}" https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1564654884073111724/bTno2FwNk5Txr5JKwt6oAwly2XJG3QRrVibjkinuBRtfahkY7IxM0QApCP6l1u99phKn
